summary: Ship-manifest audit done (read-only). 16 out-of-repo deps inventoried, 4 P0. Structural: workspace orchestrator/ is a SYMLINK to ~/.claude/orchestrator (repo==deployed). WORST DRIFT: 9 modified + 1 untracked file uncommitted (daemon loop_control+judge_edges, mcp-core, orch-gate scratch exemption, onboard scripts, loop skills, new test) — cold clone at HEAD ships an older tool surface than skills describe; plus installed ~/.claude/skills/orch-loop still instructs loop_start, a tool the running daemon no longer exposes. Recommended packaging: Claude Code plugin (already ~90% shaped: .claude-plugin/plugin.json + hooks/hooks.json + ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT} .mcp.json + skills/ auto-load), with setup-skill covering the gaps plugins can't (workspace CLAUDE.md prose, nightly-QA scheduled task, npm install, jq/node doctor, daemon restart-after-upgrade). settings.sample.json drifted (missing orch-stop hook); mcp.sample.json has an unexpanded-~ path bug. Full table + 8-step porting checklist: /Users/imyu/Desktop/cloude/scratch/competitive/D4-ship-manifest.md

item.value: STRUCTURAL: /Users/imyu/Desktop/cloude/orchestrator is a SYMLINK to ~/.claude/orchestrator — repo and deployed copy are the same dir. All drift lives in (a) uncommitted git working tree, (b) stale ~/.claude/skills hand-copies, (c) out-of-repo registrations (workspace .claude/settings.json, workspace .mcp.json, native scheduled tasks).

WORST DRIFT: 9 modified + 1 untracked file UNCOMMITTED in the orchestrator repo (daemon.js +106 loop_control/judge_edges, lib/mcp-core.js, hooks/orch-gate.sh scratch exemption, scripts/onboard*.js KB onboarding, both loop SKILL.md, test/context-gate-route.test.js). A cold clone at HEAD ships an older daemon tool surface than the skills describe. Must commit before cut.

LIVE BUG (drift): installed ~/.claude/skills/orch-loop/SKILL.md still instructs loop_start/loop_stop, but the running daemon (restarted 12:18, verified via /mcp tools/list) only exposes loop_control. Installed setup skill also missing the KB-onboarding section. The hand-copy install path is the drift generator; plugin skills/ auto-load eliminates it.

REGISTRATION STATE lives in the WORKSPACE, not global: all hooks + statusline are in /Users/imyu/Desktop/cloude/.claude/settings.json with absolute paths; ~/.claude/settings.json has no hooks (theme only). Repo hooks/hooks.json (plugin form) matches live exactly; settings.sample.json DRIFTED (missing PreToolUse '*' orch-stop.sh cooperative-stop hook). mcp.sample.json uses unexpanded '~' in node args — likely broken for manual installs.

COLD-USER GAPS the plugin manifest does NOT cover: (1) workspace CLAUDE.md product prose (dashboard link, dispatch rules, record_decision) — byte-identical copy IS in repo but plugins don't inject it into workspaces; (2) nightly-orchestrator-qa native scheduled task (~/.claude/scheduled-tasks/, 02:09) — flagship self-learn loop, registration is local-only; (3) npm install for optional @xenova/transformers + ~90MB MiniLM auto-download; (4) jq+curl required by all 9 hooks; (5) no launchd — daemon lifecycle is the SessionStart hook (fine, document); (6) mkcert binary currently NOT installed even locally (certs exist but can't regenerate).

subject: Audit local-environment dependencies for shipping
description: Inventory everything outside the orchestrator repo that the running system depends on (~/.claude hooks like orch-gate.sh and the router, settings.json registrations, skills, CLAUDE.md conventions, mcp config, certs, env). Diff local live versions against in-repo copies (drift!), and produce a ship-manifest: how each item reaches a cold user (plugin hooks.json, setup skill, install script).
